title: Man arrested after suspected air pistol found near Rochdale Armistice Day ceremony
excerpt: A 39-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of possessing an imitation firearm after police found what they believe is an air pistol near the Armistice Day ceremony in Rochdale town centre.
image_alt: Police file photo. Not a photograph of this event.
legal_disclaimer: This article was compiled from identified public sources and may be updated when further verified information becomes available.
right_to_reply: Anyone directly affected may request a correction or right of reply by emailing news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.

corrections.note: Corrected on 12 November 2026: an earlier version said the man was in his 50s; police have since given his age as 39. It also contained a statement attributed to Greater Manchester Police that police did not make, and said the arrest happened during the ceremony. Those passages have been removed and the article now reflects what police have said.

body:
A 39-year-old man has been arrested after police found what they believe to be an air pistol near the Armistice Day remembrance ceremony in Rochdale town centre on Wednesday 11 November 2026.

Greater Manchester Police said officers approached the man at about 11.30am after he appeared to be protesting near the ceremony.

Officers said they had reasonable grounds to search him and found what is believed to be an air pistol.

He was arrested on suspicion of possession of an imitation firearm and remains in custody while enquiries continue.

Police said no injuries have been reported and there is currently no evidence that the air pistol was fired.

Police also confirmed that the man did not interrupt the service and was standing some distance from the main ceremony.
